text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити gives it her all and wins the
Takarazuka
Kinen against Tamamo
Cross!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After the race, Тамамо Кросс reveals
she had
originally been looking forward
to facing Gold
City, having been
inspired by her fiery
determination.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But by the time the opportunity came,
Gold City
had found herself in a slump,
leaving Tamamo
Cross frustrated to see
her rival so affected by
public opinion.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Now, however, Голд Сити's real fighting
spirit has
returned. When she explains
that she runs for the
sake of running
itself, Тамамо Кросс is finally
satisfied.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Looking forward, Голд Сити seeks a more
grueling
challenge. She decides to run in
the Japan Cup,
where the "Beast" Oguri
Cap awaits.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
